[
  {"n": "G1", "m": true, "mc": "Per the technical notes, the page loaded and rendered cleanly in Chromium with no console or page errors."},
  {"n": "G2", "m": null, "mc": "Per the technical notes, frame rate was only tested under slow software rendering, so a real GPU test on a standard laptop is needed."},

  {"n": "1", "m": true, "mc": "Per the technical notes and parallax in the capture, the scene is rendered live via a procedural WebGL2 ray-marching shader rather than video frames."},
  {"n": "2", "m": false, "mc": "Stills 1–3 show bright white water-like patches on the far left that do not exist in the reference video."},
  {"n": "3", "m": false, "mc": "In Still 1, large bare brown fields already cut across the middle-right instead of dense broadleaf forest filling the near hills."},
  {"n": "4", "m": false, "mc": "Across Stills 1–6, the background skyline lacks the video's distinct left-of-center peak and high far-left slope, showing flatter ridges split by a gap on the left."},
  {"n": "5", "m": false, "mc": "The brown field is already exposed on the right from Still 1 and overtakes almost the entire lower half by Stills 5–6 rather than sitting in a tree-lined clearing."},
  {"n": "6", "m": false, "mc": "In Still 6 and Close-ups 1–2, only crude red, white, and blue blocks peek out behind a tall ridge, missing the rows of tunnel roofs at the lower right."},
  {"n": "7", "m": false, "mc": "In Still 2 and Close-up 4, the lower right shows wide beige striped flats and a broad pale band with no dark pond or narrow forest track."},
  {"n": "8", "m": false, "mc": "In Stills 1–6 and Close-up 4, the right valley contains only flat planes and a single large cyan block rather than terraced crop plots and scattered farm buildings."},
  {"n": "9", "m": false, "mc": "Across all stills, the sky is a washed-out pale grey-white with almost none of the reference's saturated teal-blue gradient on the right."},
  {"n": "10", "m": false, "mc": "Stills 1–6 look desaturated and hazy with pale yellow-greens, missing the video's rich foreground greens and cool blue-green distance."},
  {"n": "11", "m": false, "mc": "Sheer extruded cliff walls and giant corrugated stripes in Stills 3–6 make the scene read as an abstract heightmap rather than natural hills and valley farmland."},
  {"n": "12", "m": false, "mc": "While 3D depth is present, midground hills form unnatural vertical walls in Stills 3–6 rather than rounded slopes and folds."},
  {"n": "13", "m": false, "mc": "In Stills 1–3 and Close-ups 3–4, the canopy looks like uniform spiky green cones rather than varied broadleaf tree crowns."},
  {"n": "14", "m": false, "mc": "Close-ups 1–2 replace the parallel greenhouse rows with a few plain solid blocks mostly occluded by a steep green wall."},
  {"n": "15", "m": false, "mc": "Still 1 breaks the opening composition with large exposed brown flats on the right and bright white patches along the left hills."},
  {"n": "16", "m": true, "mc": "The horizon remains level across the entire clip from 00:00 to 00:18."},
  {"n": "17", "m": true, "mc": "Stills 1–3 show a brighter upper-left sky and directional shading on the terrain bumps lit from the upper left."},
  {"n": "18", "m": false, "mc": "In Stills 1–6, distant ridges fade toward pale grey-green rather than shifting bluer than the foreground hills."},
  {"n": "19", "m": false, "mc": "Midground valleys in Stills 3–6 are washed out by milky haze instead of retaining dark, detailed forest shadows."},
  {"n": "20", "m": false, "mc": "Close-up 3 shows smooth height transitions and wide stripe shading with no crisp shadows cast by trees onto the field edge."},
  {"n": "21", "m": false, "mc": "In Close-ups 1–4, foliage appears as smooth shaded heightfield cones and stretched green gradients rather than matte mottled leaves."},
  {"n": "22", "m": false, "mc": "Close-ups 1–3 depict the field with oversized, smooth wave ridges rather than fine plough furrows in bare soil."},
  {"n": "23", "m": false, "mc": "In Close-ups 1–2, the structures read as flat untextured white and red boxes rather than bright plastic sheeting and painted roofing."},
  {"n": "24", "m": true, "mc": "Nothing in the environment animates on its own during the capture."},
  {"n": "25", "m": true, "mc": "Per the technical notes, the procedural shader clip cuts cleanly back to the first frame at 18.5 s without blank frames."},
  {"n": "26", "m": true, "mc": "Procedural noise varies the canopy bumps across Stills 1–6 without image texture tiling or identical cloned tree meshes."},
  {"n": "27", "m": false, "mc": "Close-ups 1–4 exhibit severe vertical surface stretching along every tree-to-field drop-off and dashed ray-marching seam lines on flat ground."},
  {"n": "28", "m": false, "mc": "Stills 1–6 immediately read as low-detail procedural heightmap renders and could not pass for video frames."},
  {"n": "29", "m": true, "mc": "The camera translates straight forward at a steady pitch and roll throughout the 00:00–00:18 capture."},
  {"n": "30", "m": true, "mc": "Per the technical notes and stepped capture, the camera advances smoothly at a constant rate over an 18.5 s duration."},
  {"n": "31", "m": false, "mc": "In Still 6, corrugated brown ground fills most of the foreground while a tall green wall blocks the lower right where the greenhouse complex belongs."},
  {"n": "32", "m": false, "mc": "Newly revealed terrain in Stills 3–6 suffers from heavily stretched vertical walls and dashed ray-marching artifacts."},
  {"n": "33", "m": false, "mc": "From 00:04 to 00:11 in the capture and Close-ups 3–4, horizontal dashed artifact lines shimmer and shift across the lower-right ground."},
  {"n": "34", "m": true, "mc": "The rendered image fills the viewport cleanly to all four edges throughout the capture."},
  {"n": "35", "m": true, "mc": "Parallax in the capture separates depth properly, with near canopy passing rapidly and distant ridges barely shifting."},
  {"n": "36", "m": false, "mc": "Reveal timing does not match: no pond appears at 5 s, the field is visible from the start, and the full greenhouse complex remains hidden behind a ridge at 18 s."},
  {"n": "37", "m": false, "mc": "Side-by-side Stills 1–6 show major mismatches in terrain layout, object scale, and feature placement at every timestamp."}
]
